endorsements.quote: Ethical deployment therefore requires rigorous fairness audits, representative datasets, and continuous monitoring for disparate impacts.
Explainable AI (XAI) techniques, model documentation, and transparent reporting of limitations are essential for safe clinical integration.

unlisted_practices: Conduct pre-deployment validation, real-world testing, and post-deployment surveillance of clinical AI systems.
Continuously monitor and recalibrate clinical AI models to maintain reliability as patient populations, disease prevalence, or clinical practices shift.
Use privacy-preserving computation techniques such as federated learning and differential privacy, and secure data storage, for sensitive health data in AI systems.
Integrate informed consent and equitable access to AI-enabled healthcare services into clinical AI deployment.

screen.reason: This paper presents a comparative ethical framework and governance recommendations across multiple sectors including clinical AI applications.
